root.label: Met October 2026 Fayed abuse investigation figures

events.label: Met October 2026 Fayed abuse investigation figures

slots.name: women come forward
slots.sentence: Survivors’ groups say more than 500 women have come forward about abuse that allegedly took place at Harrods, Park Lane, Fulham football club, the Ritz hotel in Paris, and other places owned by Fayed.

slots.name: direct investigation victims
slots.sentence: The Met is investigating 165 victims who have contacted the force directly.

slots.name: represented survivors
slots.sentence: KP Law (KPL), which represents Amy and 277 other alleged survivors of Fayed’s abuse, said nearly a quarter of those women now lived overseas.

slots.name: confirmed trafficking women
slots.sentence: So far it has confirmed that five women allegedly abused by Fayed were trafficking victims.

slots.name: potential trafficking victims proportion
slots.sentence: Almost half of the women who reported allegations of sexual abuse by Mohamed Al Fayed to the Metropolitan police are potential victims of human trafficking, MPs have been told.

slots.name: Amy letter date
slots.sentence: In a letter sent in June to the then minister for safeguarding and violence against women and girls, Natalie Fleet, Amy raised concerns about the apparent exclusion of survivors living outside the UK from the Home Office assessment of potential trafficking victims, the National Referral Mechanism (NRM).
